title: Visibility and Peer Influence in Durable Good Adoption
authors: Bryan K. Bollinger; Kenneth T. Gillingham; A. Justin Kirkpatrick; Steven Sexton
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. The main specifications are household-month adoption (hazard) regressions of solar installation (dv / isInstall) on counts of prior installations within distance d (CT_d), counts of visible installations (tVise_d), EV interactions, and household characteristics (home value, square footage, wealth score, marital status, children, length of residence, party), with tract or block-group FE and year-month FE (reghdfe ... a(tract ym) / a(geoid ym) / a(hhid ym)). Treatment regressors are continuous peer counts; some columns instrument tVise with tVisd (2SLS), and robustness uses ppmlhdfe / xtpoisson. No binary staggered adoption indicator. The prescore of 2 reflects unit and time FE only.
design_notes: MKTSCI code - econometric analysis/setup_code_18.do lists the run order. reg_market_timeFE_SS.do: reghdfe dv adopted EV CT_d EV_d tVise_d <household covariates> if OWNER, a(tract ym | geoid ym | hhid ym) vce(cluster ...); IV columns (tVise_d = tVisd_d). reg_ppmlhdfe_market_timeFE_SS*.do: Poisson versions. Placebo files use next-year (_ny) peer counts. Solarize CT program dates are shipped (Data MKTSCI/Shared/SolarizeCT_program_dates.rds) but enter only as the isSolarize indicator in data construction, not as a DiD treatment in the regression files.
estimators_reported: linear probability hazard with peer-count regressors and FE
n_eligible_specs_note: Continuous peer-count regressors in every specification.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous peer-count regressors; time-varying controls; IV and Poisson variants
specs.code_file: mksc.2021.1306/MKSC-19-0171 public code/MKTSCI code - econometric analysis/reg_market_timeFE_SS.do
specs.treatment_var: CT_d, tVise_d, EV_d (counts of nearby / visible installations)
specs.fe: tract or geoid or hhid, ym
specs.controls: adopted EV TOTAL_VALUE_CALCULATED BUILDING_SQUARE_FEET LAND_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FIPS_APN_count_d WEALTH_FINDER_SCORE FIND_DIV_1000 MARRIED CHILDREN_IND LENGTH_OF_RESIDENCE Independent Democrat
